name: Savory Cottage Cheese with Cucumber, Tomato & Sesame Seeds
instructions: Wash, dry, and halve tomatoes lengthwise. Place in a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, trim, and medium dice cucumber. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes and stir to combine.
To serve, divide cottage cheese, tomato, and cucumber between bowls. Drizzle with oil, then sprinkle with sesame seeds, salt, and pepper. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
